info.title: Electric Wealth API
info.description: REST API for the Electric Wealth web app. Money values are integers in minor units (cents). Errors use the ErrorEnvelope shape. Demo sign-in: any persona email, password `Demo123!`, MFA code `123456`.

bearerAuth.description: Access token from POST /api/auth/token, after POST /api/auth/mfa/verify.

days.description: The next five business days, starting tomorrow

challengeId.description: Opaque challenge id (the demo accepts any value)

totalValue.description: Sum of visible account balances (minor units)

expiresAt.description: The shared link stops working after this time (7 days)
